_read_me: Every price, plan name and 'what's included' line on the site comes from this file. Change it, run `npm run prices`, commit. Anything with "confirmed": false is a draft: it shows with a dotted amber underline, and the release gate (`npm run release-check`) fails until it is set to true. Prices, the monthly list and the terms were confirmed by Eli on 2026-10-31; the plan names (Starter, Plus, Premium, Custom) on 2026-11-11.

names._read_me: Eli chose the "plain" set on 2026-11-11. "confirmed" covers the set in use, so switching sets needs Eli again. The keys starter/standard/large are internal and never shown.

lines._read_me: Single sentences on the pages that depend on what's in the price. Use one with .
